description: Give a project (what it does, for whom) and constraints; get resources from the AgentGid catalog that could add a feature to it or start a new project, each with one concrete scenario (task, data, action, result and the limit of what the data covers), how to start, access (key, price, download) and terms (commercial use with its condition, credit line). Use it for 'what could my app add', 'what can I build with open data about X' and 'which data may I use commercially for Y'. get_resource gives the full card.

category.description: Optional category slug, e.g. transport, ai-datasets, museums-art

commercial.description: Only resources whose terms allow commercial use (yes or with conditions)

no_key.description: Only APIs that work without a key

project.description: The project or the need in a sentence, e.g. 'travel app for Spain, pick a railway station on a map'

region.description: Optional country or city the data must cover, e.g. Spain, Paris

name: find_project_ideas
title: Project ideas from open data and sites
